recoveryProcedure.onPreflightFailure: Abort immediately. Zero database mutations have occurred.
recoveryProcedure.onMigrationFailure: PostgreSQL transaction aborts per statement. Supabase migration ledger tracks applied versions. Do NOT manually edit schema_migrations table. Inspect exact error log, keep services intact, and escalate to CTO.
recoveryProcedure.onPostflightFailure: Postflight runs in a read-only transaction (or DO block). If any invariant fails, escalate to CTO immediately. If manual rollback is required, drop the unapproved app_moderation_v2 schema in a discrete, reviewed maintenance window, remove the 2 settings keys, and delete the 3 ledger records.
recoveryProcedure.rollbackScriptDescription: DROP SCHEMA app_moderation_v2 CASCADE; DELETE FROM public.app_system_settings WHERE setting_key IN ('moderation_v2_enabled', 'moderation_v2_mode'); DELETE FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations WHERE version IN ('20261018172250', '20261018182448', '20261019102255');
